question: In the rendered artifact bytes, does every drawn participant-name token sit in a blank this family listed as one the name belongs in?
method: Every flattened appearance in each fixture is read and matched back to the censused blank at its own measured rectangle. This is wider than the charge-caption question.
theAllowlistIsEmptyBecause: The one blank on TC0021 where a petitioner's name belongs — the NAME, ADDRESS AND PHONE NUMBER block at page 1 x 21.55..267.16, y 650.84..717.17 — is refused by role, because the shared binder has no composite fact for a three-line identity block and binds it to participant.phone alone. In this build no participant name may be drawn anywhere on the form, so ANY name token found in the bytes is a blocking finding.
